name: Priscilla Shutter
message:
Dear Sir or Madame 1/20/99

My name is Priscilla Shutter and I smoke your cigarettes. The Mustang, full flavor. And in one of your packs of cigarettes there was a bug. I guess they are tobacco bugs. One of my friends told me to write to you and tell you and maybe you'll refund or send me cigs or money. I don't usually buy the Mustang cigarettes anymore since then.

Thank you
Priscilla Shutter
